name: Plou (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and blue below, charged with a white monument at the hoist and a green plant at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Plou; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: monument (peirón) with a cross at the lower hoist
